nodes.label: A UAV control is safely handed over from autonomous pilot (AP)  to a human operator
Argue that the system prevents any dramatic, dangerous UAV reponses
Handover must be initiated by the human who will manually fly the drone.
The system must have an inbuilt failsafe to prevent the UAV from flying dramatically and dangerously.
Argue that the system mitigates hand over control issues.
Argue that the system implements failsafe mechanisms to prevent the UAV from responding dramatically during hand over.
The system should not allow the autonomous pilot to automatically hand control to the human operator as the operator might be unprepared to take control.
Coordination must occur between the two roles of the autonomous pilot and the human operator
The UAV may descend rapidly but will stop and hover before reaching the ground, ifthe throttle is set downwards.
The UAV may ascend rapidly but will stop and hover before reaching the limited altitude, if the throttle is set upwards.
